gloss: Japanese food restaurant; Japanese cuisine restaurant

definitions.gloss: Japanese food restaurant; Japanese cuisine restaurant
definitions.explanation: A restaurant specializing in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{和食屋|わしょくや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is there a Japanese restaurant nearby?

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{和食屋|わしょくや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: That Japanese restaurant requires a reservation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{和食屋|わしょくや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new Japanese restaurant opened in front of the station.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ (Japanese food/cuisine) and ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop/restaurant). The ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ suffix is productive and forms names for various types of shops and restaurants. {和食屋|わしょくや} is used when the speaker wants to specify Japanese cuisine as opposed to other types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和食屋|わしょくや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat at a Japanese restaurant
- {和食屋|わしょくや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a Japanese restaurant
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{和食屋|わしょくや}: upscale Japanese restaurant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧: Japanese restaurant — more formal, uses the loanword
- {日本料理店|にほんりょうりてん}: Japanese cuisine restaurant — more formal and specific
- ⟦{割烹|かっぽう}→割烹：11922_kappou⟧: traditional Japanese restaurant — implies a more refined, chef-driven dining experience
- ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧: high-class Japanese restaurant — exclusive establishments with private rooms
